q1.explanationZh: look like“看上去像”，后面接名词，如 He looks like a scholar.

q2.explanationZh: laugh at sb.“嘲笑某人”，与 make fun of 意思相近。

q3.explanationZh: keep doing sth.“继续做某事”，keep 后面用动词的 -ing 形式，相当于 go on doing sth.。

q4.explanationZh: look at“看；观看”，强调看的动作，后面接要看的对象。

q5.explanationZh: look up 有两个意思：“（在词典里）查寻”和“抬头看”，如 look up a word in the dictionary。

q6.explanationZh: leave (secondary) school“（中学）毕业”，括号里的 secondary 可以省略。

q7.explanationZh: keep off“阻挡；不让……接近”，如 Keep off the grass.（勿踩草地）

q8.explanationZh: listen to“听……”，后面接人或声音，to 不能漏掉：listen to me。

q9.explanationZh: leave for + 地点“动身去某地”，注意不是 leave（离开）某地。

q10.explanationZh: jump to a conclusion“贸然断定；草率决定”，conclusion 是“结论”。

q11.explanationZh: live on“靠……为生；以……为主食”，如 live on rice。

q12.explanationZh: in trouble“处于困境中”，如 help people in trouble。

q13.explanationZh: just now“刚才”，与 a moment ago 意思相同，句子用一般过去时。

q14.explanationZh: keep sb. busy“让某人忙个不停”，sb. 放在 keep 和 busy 中间。

q15.explanationZh: look forward to“期待着”，to 是介词，后面接名词或动词 -ing 形式。

q16.explanationZh: keep fit“保持健康”，与 keep healthy 意思相近。

q17.explanationZh: look for“寻找”，强调找的过程；find 是“找到”。

q18.explanationZh: keep in touch (with sb.)“（与某人）保持联系”，with 后接联系的对象。

q19.explanationZh: instead of“代替；而不是”，of 是介词，后面接名词或动词 -ing 形式。

q20.explanationZh: leave a message“留个口信”，打电话时常用：May I leave a message?

q21.explanationZh: keep a diary“记日记”，这里 keep 表示“坚持记”。

q22.explanationZh: look after“照料；照顾”，与 take care of 意思相同。

q23.explanationZh: learn sth. from sb.“向某人学习某事”，学的内容放在 learn 和 from 中间。

q24.explanationZh: keep sb. from doing sth.“阻止某人做某事”，与 prevent…from、stop…from 意思相同。

q25.explanationZh: less than“少于”，more than“多于”，两个词组都要写出。

q26.explanationZh: “丧生”= lose one’s life；主语是 He，one’s 换成 his；didn’t want to 后用动词原形 lose。

q27.explanationZh: “而不是”= instead of，后面接动词 -ing 形式 staying。

q28.explanationZh: “刚才”= just now，句中 left 是过去式，与 just now 搭配。

q29.explanationZh: “阻止某人做某事”= keep sb. from doing sth.；主语 this 是第三人称单数，一般现在时用 keeps。

q30.explanationZh: “嘲笑”= laugh at；It’s impolite to do sth. 中 to 后用动词原形。

q31.explanationZh: “不让接近”= keep off，keep off the grass 即“勿踩草地”；told sb. to do 后用原形。

q32.explanationZh: “保持安静”= keep quiet；won’t 后面用动词原形。

q33.explanationZh: “注意；当心”= look out，相当于 be careful；tell sb. to do 后用原形。

q34.explanationZh: “迷路”= lose one’s way；主语 They，one’s 换成 their；讲过去发生的事，lose 用过去式 lost。

q35.explanationZh: “（饭前）摆好餐具”= lay the table；and 前的 came 是过去式，lay 也要用过去式 laid。

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q36.explanationZh: “看上去像”= look like；主语 He 是第三人称单数，用 looks。

q37.sampleAnswer: As middle school students, we should know how to look after ourselves.
references: As middle school students, we should know how to look after ourselves.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q37.explanationZh: “作为”= as；“如何照顾”= how to look after；“我们自己”= ourselves。

q38.sampleAnswer: I practise yoga to keep fit.
references: I practise yoga to keep fit.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q38.explanationZh: “来保持健康”用动词不定式 to keep fit 表示目的。

q39.sampleAnswer: That job will keep you busy for a long time.
references: That job will keep you busy for a long time.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q39.explanationZh: “让你忙碌”= keep you busy，you 放在 keep 和 busy 中间；“会”用 will。

q40.sampleAnswer: How does Jack keep in touch with his friends in America every week?
references: How does Jack keep in touch with his friends in America every week?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q40.explanationZh: “如何”用 How 开头的一般现在时问句：How does Jack keep in touch with…?

q41.sampleAnswer: Look forward to hearing more details from you soon.
references: Look forward to hearing more details from you soon.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q41.explanationZh: look forward to 中的 to 是介词，后面用 hearing；“从你那儿听到”= hear from you。

q42.sampleAnswer: Her sister wanted to further her study instead of looking for a job.
references: Her sister wanted to further her study instead of looking for a job.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q42.explanationZh: “找工作”= look for a job；instead of 后面用 -ing 形式 looking；further 在这里是动词“促进，深造”。

q43.sampleAnswer: I had to seek a living before I left secondary school.
references: I had to seek a living before I left secondary school.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q43.explanationZh: “中学毕业”= leave secondary school；“没毕业就……”可以说 before I left secondary school；讲过去的事用过去式。

q44.sampleAnswer: The young policeman always helps the old when they are in trouble.
references: The young policeman always helps the old when they are in trouble.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q44.explanationZh: “处于困难中”= be in trouble；“老人”= the old；always 表示经常，用一般现在时 helps。

q45.sampleAnswer: You’d better not look up every new word in the dictionary because you can guess its meaning from the context.
references: You’d better not look up every new word in the dictionary because you can guess its meaning from the context.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q45.explanationZh: “你最好不要”= You’d better not + 动词原形；“在词典里查”= look up … in the dictionary；“上下文”= context。
